title: Sugar-Free Cheesecake for Two
intro: Made with monkfruit sweetener and a homemade sugar-free Biscoff spread.

items: 120 grams cream cheese at room temperature obv @dlectaproducts
50 grams of my homemade biscoff spread (sugar free) or any topping of choice

method: Start by lining your 4 inch tin with foil on the bottom and parchment paper as well ( shown in video)
Combine your crust ingredients in a bowl and press down firmly
Bake at 180 for 5-6 minutes, take out and leave to cool
Add your cheesecake ingredients in a bowl adding the egg last and combine gently
Bake at 180 degrees oven for 25 ish minutes till sides are set and centre has a slight giggle
Fridge to cool for 4 hours minimum
Eat as is or top with fresh fruit / spread of choice
caption:
Sugar-Free Cheesecake for 2
monkfruit sweetener|homemade sugar free biscoff spread

crust:
¼ cup ( around 60 grams) crushed digestive biscuits | use more if you are a crust person 
1 tbsp monk fruit sugar 
1 tbsp butter, melted

cheesecake
120 grams cream cheese at room temperature obv @dlectaproducts 
2-3 tbsp monk fruit sugar 
1 ½ tbsp thick dahi 
1 ½ tbsp Amul cream 
¼ tsp vanilla essence 
½ tsp flour
1 egg 

50 grams of my homemade biscoff spread (sugar free) or any topping of choice
 
Method: 
Start by lining your 4 inch tin with foil on the bottom and parchment paper as well ( shown in video) 
combine your crust ingredients in a bowl and press down firmly
bake at 180 for 5-6 minutes, take out and leave to cool
add your cheesecake ingredients in a bowl adding the egg last and combine gently 
add to your cheesecake base 
Bake at 180 degrees oven for 25 ish minutes till sides are set and centre has a slight giggle
Fridge to cool for 4 hours minimum 
eat as is or top with fresh fruit / spread of choice
